messages:
oncall-bot: PAGER: High GPU queue growth in prod (us-west-2). autoscaler reports repeated AddNode failures. Severity: page. @maya is on-call.

maya: Ack. seeing a spike in inference queue length on endpoint /text-gen-1, 95th latency > 10s and a backlog of ~820 requests. Investigating.

alex: i'm here, pulling autoscaler logs. can you confirm region and cluster?

maya: cluster: prod-gpu-02 (k8s 1.26), region us-west-2. Traffic started rising ~1738892000.

jamie: grabbing cluster-autoscaler logs now. logs show repeated failures to attach instances to ASG due to LaunchTemplate mismatch + instance profile error. snippet: 
```
I0523 12:45:01 autoscaler.go:123] Failed to expand group prod-gpu-02-ng-gpu: error when creating instance: InvalidParameter: LaunchTemplateVersion "lt-202" does not exist
error: AccessDenied: iam:PassRole denied for role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodNodeInstanceProfile
```

samira: that looks like a launch template drift after rolling a new image earlier today. new LT version wasn't published to the autoscale group.

leo: also seeing taint application errors on new nodes once they come up. kubelet logs: 
```
E0705 12:46:05 taints.go:45] failed to add taint gpu-spot=true: permission denied updating node spec: forbidden: User "system:node:ip-..." cannot update resource "nodes"
```

maya: customer impact: endpoints degraded, a subset of requests failing with 503 or timing out after retries. Not full outage but large % of real-time customers affected. hitting rate-limit fallback for a few internal customers.

product-ops: Any major customers impacted? we need to prepare comms if a VIP workload is affected.

maya: early check: three paying accounts saw 15–30% error rate increases for 20m. will compile list.

alex: immediate mitigation plan: (1) stop churn-ish rollout by pinning autoscale group to working LT, (2) manually create emergency nodegroup with corrected LT + instance profile and scale to 6 GPUs, (3) temporarily relax taint checks to let pods schedule, (4) restart autoscaler after applying LT fix.

jamie: attempting manual nodegroup creation with eksctl now. command: 
```
eksctl create nodegroup --cluster prod-gpu-02 --name emergency-gpu-01 --node-type p4d.24xlarge --nodes 6 --node-ami auto --asg-access --node-iam-role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodNodeInstanceProfile --launch-template-version 201
```

pagerbot: Deploy bot: manual nodegroup creation started by jamie. ETA ~7-10m for instance provisioning.

samira: while that's provisioning, we can also patch the cluster-autoscaler configmap to ignore minor LT mismatches and avoid immediate failures. patch: 
```
kubectl -n kube-system patch configmap cluster-autoscaler --type merge -p '{"data":{"ignore-launch-template-errors":"true"}}'
```
(note: temporary, will revert).

leo: I don't love toggling that because it hides real issues, but agreed it's okay short-term to let autoscaler attempt other groups. add an alert to revert.

maya: jamie — any progress?

jamie: new nodegroup provisioned, instances are InService. nodes joined cluster but flagged NotReady initially. kubelet is failing to add required taints because the instance profile didn't have sts:AssumeRole properly attached. re-applying instance profile policy now.

alex: once nodes become Ready and taints applied, we should cordon+drain a small batch from the pending queue to move pods. but queues are long; we might also temporarily increase replica counts for fallback workers to handle short-term throughput.

jamie: taint application fixed, nodes now showing label gpu=true and taint node-role.kubernetes.io/gpu=:NoSchedule applied. scheduling of pending GPU pods started.

oncall-bot: Incident timeline appended to channel.

maya: monitoring shows queue drain starting at 1738894500, backlog down from 820 to 180 in ~6m. 95th latency is returning toward baseline. errors down but still elevated.

product-ops: good. start drafting status update: summarize root cause (LT/version drift + IAM PassRole missing causing autoscaler add failures + taint application failure on node bootstrap), mitigation (manual nodegroup, fix instance profile, temporary autoscaler configmap change), customer impact (partial degradation for subset for ~40m).

samira: next steps: 1) reconcile launch template versions across ASGs and pipeline releases, 2) add CI check to ensure new LT versions publish to all target ASGs, 3) make cluster-autoscaler more resilient in our config and surface clearer metrics when PassRole/Ops IAM errors occur.

leo: also recommend move to an immutable launch template lifecycle in infra pipeline so autoscale groups reference explicit LT ids that are verified before rollout.

maya: handing off to SRE rotation to continue cleanup and postmortem. @alex you're primary for postmortem writeup, @jamie for infra remediation items, @samira for automation tickets.

alex: ack takeover. I'll keep monitoring for 30m then start postmortem. adding quick timeline notes here.

pagerbot: Reminder: @alex, @jamie, @samira — please acknowledge incident handoff within 10m.

alex: acked.

jamie: acked.

samira: acked.

maya: final note: we should flag a follow-up runbook update to include this LT drift scenario and a checklist for emergency manual scaling. closing page to monitoring state; we'll reopen if reoccurs. :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: Incident resolved-ish: backlog drained and autoscaler stabilized. Closing page at 1738894760.

maya: logging customer-impact details in ops-incident tracker and will follow up with a brief notification to affected customers tomorrow AM.

alex: will start the postmortem doc and link to this thread. thanks all for fast triage. :heart:
